title: St. Michael's Catholic Church, 519 East Third Street, Madison, Jefferson County, IN
notes: See also HABS IN-85, St. Michael's Rectory.

Significance: St. Michael's Church is the oldest church building in Madison, and is still in constant use.  It is probably the oldest existing Gothic Revival structure in Indiana, and was among the first built, as well.
National Register of Historic Places NRIS Number: 73000020
